title: Signed-out access to a protected record requires sign-in
steps: Open /results/1 in a fresh browser context.
expected: Sign-in form is visible and patient record content is absent.

title: Empty sign-in cannot submit
expected: Username receives native required-field validation.

title: Incorrect credentials produce readable feedback
steps: Enter a nonexistent username and wrong password.
expected: An invalid-credentials alert appears without authenticated navigation.

title: Password visibility control preserves the entered value
steps: Click Show password, then Hide password.
expected: Input switches password → text → password without changing its value.

title: Registration offers three distinct account routes
steps: Click Create an account from sign-in.
expected: Patient, Family caregiver, and Care team options are separate navigable choices.

title: Care-team registration explains approval and limits requested roles
steps: Inspect requested-role options and approval notice.
expected: Role choice includes clinical/office roles but not Administrator; approval requirement is visible.

title: Registration account choice can be changed before submission
expected: Family caregiver account form replaces the patient form.

title: Blank registration identifies required information
expected: Username validation blocks account creation.

title: Malformed registration email is rejected
steps: Replace email with not-an-email and submit.
expected: Browser validation identifies invalid email and keeps the user on registration.

title: Mismatched registration passwords are rejected
steps: Fill a valid Patient registration with different password confirmation.
expected: A do-not-match error is shown; no account is created.

title: Weak numeric registration password is rejected
steps: Fill Patient registration with matching password 12345678.
expected: A password-strength error is visible and registration remains open.

title: New patient can register and reach their own dashboard
steps: Fill a valid unique synthetic Patient registration.
expected: Dashboard welcomes Atlas and shows personal account navigation.

title: Authenticated session survives a page refresh
steps: Refresh the newly registered patient dashboard.
expected: Atlas remains signed in and is not returned to sign-in.

title: Duplicate username cannot register a second account
steps: Use a separate signed-out browser context.
Submit registration with the existing synthetic username.
expected: An already-in-use error prevents duplicate creation.

title: Patient contact information can be updated
steps: Sign in as the synthetic patient.
Set phone and address; save profile.
expected: Save confirmation is visible and entered values remain displayed.

title: Saved profile persists across a new sign-in session
steps: Sign in to the synthetic account and open Account Settings.
expected: Previously saved phone and address are prefilled.

title: Muting one notification category persists without muting others
steps: Mute Test result in synthetic account settings.
expected: Test result shows Unmute while Message still shows Mute.

title: A muted category can be re-enabled and stays enabled
expected: Test result returns to the Mute action after reload.

title: Password change requires matching confirmation
steps: Enter current password and different new-password confirmations.
expected: A mismatch alert appears without changing the password.

title: Password change rejects incorrect current password
steps: Enter a wrong current password and valid matching new passwords.
expected: Current-password-incorrect alert appears.

title: Valid password change clears sensitive fields and confirms success
steps: Enter the correct current password and matching new passwords on the synthetic account.
expected: Password-changed confirmation appears and all three password fields are empty.

title: Old password no longer grants access after a change
steps: Attempt sign-in with the old password.
expected: Invalid-credentials alert prevents dashboard access.

title: New password signs the patient in successfully
steps: Sign in in a fresh session using the new password.
expected: Atlas dashboard appears.

title: Sign-out removes identity and protects browser-back access
steps: Sign in, then open Account Settings to create protected-page browser history.
Sign out, use browser Back and reload.
expected: Sign-in remains required and Atlas identity is absent.

title: Mobile sign-in fits a narrow viewport
expected: Credentials and submit are visible without horizontal page overflow.

title: Mobile navigation opens, navigates, and closes correctly
steps: Open menu and select Account Settings.
Open menu again and press Escape.
expected: Settings opens; navigation closes on route selection and Escape; no horizontal overflow.

title: Sign-in can be completed with keyboard navigation
steps: Press Tab to Password and type password.
expected: Keyboard-only form submission opens Atlas dashboard.

title: Registration provides a usable route back to sign-in
expected: Sign-in page opens with its credentials form.

title: Forgot-password form validates a missing email
expected: Required email validation prevents submission.

title: Public forgotten-password recovery can deliver a reset request
expected: A recovery request is accepted and Check your email is shown. Known deployment limitation: external recovery delivery is not configured.

title: Incomplete reset URL offers recovery without exposing a form
steps: Follow Request a new reset link.
expected: Readable incomplete-link notice appears, then Forgot password opens.

title: Unavailable record gives understandable feedback and a way back
steps: Sign in as the synthetic patient.
expected: Readable unavailable alert appears with no raw model error, and Test Results list opens.

title: Unknown portal route offers a working home link
expected: Page unavailable appears, and Home returns to the correct dashboard.

title: New patient sees a clear empty notification state
steps: Sign in to the synthetic account.
expected: Notification heading and empty-record message appear without an error.

title: Switching administrator to patient removes privileged workspace state
steps: Open Laboratory results and sign out.
Sign in as the synthetic patient without refreshing.
expected: Patient dashboard replaces staff shell; staff controls and administrator identity are absent; /staff cannot expose management UI.
